en: A black and white postcard image showing a coastal scene with numerous birds, mainly terns and gulls, nesting among tall grasses. The background reveals a coastline with water and sandbanks. There is Swedish text labeling the types of birds, the location ('Måkläppen utanför Falsterbo, juni 1920'), and credits to the Gothenburg Natural History Museum and a diorama by Olof Gylling.
